title: have…in common — situation comedy

sentences.sentence: As a magician, his reputation spread all over the world.
sentences.translation: 作为一个魔术师，他的名声传播到了世界各地。

sentences.sentence: Roll up, roll up! See how the magician performs his tricks!
sentences.translation: 快来看，快来看!看看魔术师怎么表演他的魔术!

sentences.sentence: The children's eyes goggled as the magician pulled a rabbit out of the empty hat.
sentences.translation: 当魔术师从空帽子中拉出兔子时，孩子们瞪大眼睛看着。

sentences.sentence: No, blacks have all kinds of jobs.
sentences.translation: 不，黑人从事各种各样的工作。

sentences.translation: 这对我来说很可怕，但我得到了各种各样的反馈。

sentences.translation: 到目前为止，科学家们几乎没有该药物在防止更严重的感染后果的功能的明确证据。

sentences.sentence: Matthews plays the role of a young doctor suspected of murder.
sentences.translation: 马修斯扮演一名涉嫌谋杀的年轻医生。

sentences.sentence: I think this may be an extraordinary moment in history where Africa can become a continent of hope and the Bank can play a role in that.
sentences.translation: 他说："我认为，这可能是历史上一个不同寻常的时刻，使非洲成为一个希望的大陆，世行可以在这方面发挥作用。

sentences.sentence: Five lucky winners will each receive a signed copy of the album.
sentences.translation: 五位幸运的获胜者每人将得到一张签名专辑。

sentences.translation: 作为骑师他曾十度驾驭获胜赛马。

sentences.sentence: The total prize money was £30,000.

sentences.translation: 我认为你编造关于他的故事是很不友好的。

sentences.sentence: It’s time we talked seriously about our relationship.

sentences.translation: 我不是偷的！是玛丽亚给我的！

sentences.translation: 大多数人都愿意向慈善事业捐款。

sentences.translation: 现在情况危急，请大家慷慨解囊。

sentences.translation: 火车很挤，我们只好站着。

sentences.sentence: Carol was very excited that I was interested in our family's history, even if it was just because a former sitcom actress told me to be.

sentences.sentence: Examples of this would be a half-hour sitcom, a one-hour drama, an episodic documentary, a how-to program such as cooking or home repair or a reality show.
sentences.translation: 包括半小时的情景喜剧，一小时的剧情片，一部插话式的纪录片，一个诸如烹饪或家居修补或真人秀的指引类节目。

sentences.sentence: The situation comedy is going to start soon, just switch to channel one.
sentences.translation: 情景喜剧马上就要开播了，快调到一频道。

sentences.sentence: Lucy and Desi used a three-camera system on I Love Lucy allowing them to film their show for later broadcast, creating the TV situation comedy as we know it today.
sentences.translation: 露西和德西用三位摄像机系统录制《我爱露西》，这使他们可以将此节目制成电影来播放，这也就诞生了我们今日所熟悉的这部电视喜剧。

sentences.sentence: As a TV program type, situation comedy has been in America for more than 50 years, and it developed well.
sentences.translation: 作为一种电视节目类型，情景喜剧在美国已经有50多年的历史，而且发展成熟。

have…in common
有相同特征

magician
音标：英 /mə'dʒɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /mə'dʒɪʃən/
n. 魔术师；术士

快来看，快来看!看看魔术师怎么表演他的魔术!

all kinds of
各种各样；各种类型
例句：No, blacks have all kinds of jobs.
不，黑人从事各种各样的工作。

这对我来说很可怕，但我得到了各种各样的反馈。
